author: Mark Atwood
text: Blocked on JMAP-826m.14. The unit-vs-integration test duplication noted here is the same canonical-template question .14 is asking. If .14 resolves toward option (i) 'drop MockBackend entirely; move all tests to tests/ using MemoryBackend', the duplication evaporates by structural means. If .14 resolves toward (ii) or (iii), keeping both surfaces is a deliberate choice that needs separate justification per test.
